dashboard.obsGuideTitle: 📖 How to set up in OBS (click for steps)
dashboard.obsGuideStep1: Open OBS and look at the "Sources" box at the bottom
dashboard.obsGuideStep2: Click + → choose "Browser" → name it e.g. TipTang Alert → click OK
dashboard.obsGuideStep3: In the "URL" field, clear the default text and paste the link copied above
dashboard.obsGuideStep4: Set Width = 800 and Height = 300, then click OK
dashboard.obsGuideStep5: Done! Click "Preview/Test" above to check the alert pops up on your OBS screen
dashboard.obsGuideNote: Drag the card anywhere on your OBS scene · background is transparent, it won't cover your game

guide.title: Get started with TipTang in 5 minutes
guide.intro: Follow these 5 steps and start receiving PromptPay donations on your stream — 100% free, no fees.
guide.browserHint: 🚀 Opening from a chat app (LINE/Messenger)? For the smoothest experience, tap the three-dot menu and choose "Open in browser" (Chrome/Safari) before signing up.
guide.step1Desc: Create an account at tiptang.com with just an email — free, no cost.
guide.step2Desc: Go to Settings, enter the PromptPay number that will receive the money and your display name — donations go straight to this account.
guide.step2Hint: (for users who have already signed up)
guide.step3Desc: So donations pop on screen during your live, with sound + effects.
guide.step4Title: Share your profile link with fans
guide.step4Desc: Copy your profile link from the dashboard and post it under your clips/profile — viewers scan the QR and pay from any app (bank / TrueMoney Wallet).
guide.obsLeadIn: After you sign up and log in, go to the dashboard to copy your private Overlay link, then follow these steps in OBS:
guide.obsStep1: Open OBS → in the Sources box, click +
guide.obsStep2: Choose Browser → name it e.g. TipTang → click OK
guide.obsStep3: Paste the Overlay link (copied from the dashboard) into the URL field
guide.obsStep4: Set Width = 800, Height = 300 → OK (background is transparent automatically)
guide.step5Desc: Hit "Test" to see the alert pop up, then start your live and receive donations — 100% free, 0% fee, you keep every baht.
guide.why1: 100% free & unlimited, no fees — money goes straight to your PromptPay
guide.why2: on-screen overlay + Subathon timer + selectable alert effects
guide.why3: a TipMe alternative — easy to switch, set up in 5 minutes

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: TipTang respects your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it, in line with Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).
privacy.s1Body:
• Account info: email, password (stored hashed — never the plain password), display name, bio, profile/cover images
• The creator's PromptPay ID (sensitive — stored securely server-side, never exposed to donors or the public)
• Donation info: supporter name/message, amount, transfer slip, transaction reference
• Technical info: IP address (for rate-limiting and security)
privacy.s2Body:
• To run the service — receive donations, show stream alerts, and your profile page
• To confirm transfers and prevent slip reuse / fraud
• To email creators when a new donation arrives
• To maintain and secure the platform
We do not use your data for advertising and we do not sell it.
privacy.s3Body: Data is stored on Supabase infrastructure (database and file storage). Passwords are one-way hashed, and PromptPay IDs are never sent to the public client. We apply reasonable safeguards, but no system is 100% secure.
privacy.s4Body: We do not sell or rent your personal data. We may share data only as needed with service providers that help operate the platform — e.g. hosting (Vercel), database/storage (Supabase), email delivery, and slip-verification services (if enabled) — or when required by law.
privacy.s5Body: You have the right to access, obtain a copy of, correct, delete, or object to / withdraw consent for the processing of your personal data, including requesting account deletion. Contact us to exercise these rights.
privacy.s6Body: We keep data only as long as needed to provide the service. When you delete your account, we delete or anonymize your personal data, except where the law requires us to keep it.
privacy.s7Body: For questions about this policy or to exercise your rights, contact us at support@tiptang.com

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Please read these terms before using TipTang. By signing up or using the service, you agree to them.
terms.s1Body: TipTang is a free tool that helps creators receive PromptPay donations and show on-stream alerts (overlays). TipTang is not an intermediary that holds or transfers funds — donations go directly from the supporter to the creator's bank/PromptPay account. Transfer slips are used only to confirm transactions.
terms.s2Body: TipTang is free to use, with no fees and no percentage cut from your donations (0%), because we never hold your money.
terms.s3Body:
• You must provide accurate information, especially the PromptPay ID used to receive money
• You are responsible for keeping your account and password secure
• You are responsible for the content on your profile/stream and must comply with the law
terms.s4Body: You may not use TipTang for fraud, money laundering, illegal activities or content, or infringing others' rights. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate these terms.
terms.s5Body: TipTang is provided "as is", without warranty that it will be error-free or always available. TipTang is not a bank, financial institution, or payment provider, and is not responsible for disputes, refunds, or transfer issues between supporters and creators, to the extent permitted by law.
terms.s6Body: You may stop using or delete your account at any time. We may improve or discontinue the service and may update these terms from time to time. Continued use means you accept the updated terms.
terms.s7Body: These terms are governed by the laws of Thailand. For questions, contact support@tiptang.com
